title: 9. Human-Human Fruit (Hito Hito no Mi, Chopper)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.english: 9. Human-Human Fruit (Hito Hito no Mi, Chopper)
plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird mushroom-shaped#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird mushroom-shaped fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Zoan that lets an animal#blue turn into a human.#purple
lines.say: a Zoan that lets an animal turn into a human.

lines.text: First, a little reindeer#red becomes#blue able to talk and walk like a person.
lines.say: First, a little reindeer becomes able to talk and walk like a person.

lines.text: Then you switch#red between#blue a cute small form and a giant strong form.
lines.say: Then you switch between a cute small form and a giant strong form.

lines.text: With a Rumble#blue Ball, you unlock even more forms for three minutes.#pink
lines.say: With a Rumble Ball, you unlock even more forms for three minutes.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue form is Monster#orange Point: a giant beast with huge power.
lines.say: Your strongest form is Monster Point: a giant beast with huge power.

lines.text: If you lose control,#purple you can't tell friends#green from enemies.
lines.say: If you lose control, you can't tell friends from enemies.

lines.text: Tony Tony Chopper,#purple the Straw Hats' doctor, ate it as a little reindeer.#blue
lines.say: Tony Tony Chopper, the Straw Hats' doctor, ate it as a little reindeer.

lines.text: Users of this fruit are not a raccoon.#orange
lines.say: Users of this fruit are not a raccoon.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
